title: Keep brokerage transactions connected to their source rows
summary: The optional financial table reader keeps dates and amounts together when the original PDF proves that two brokerage transactions were combined.
bodyMarkdown:
## What changed

The optional financial table reader can separate combined 1099-B transactions when the original PDF supports both dates, each amount and a shared security description. Shared descriptions remain one source cell spanning the transactions.

## Why it matters

Tables with contradictory column ordering or unresolved transaction rows are withheld for review instead of offered for export. This does not automatically approve tax facts.

## Where to find it

Use Extract Tables in the PDF toolbox. Availability depends on the optional financial table reader being enabled; general rollout remains under qualification.
